description: Full 24-month (2025-01-01 through 2026-12-31) synthetic QuestShelf evaluation dataset containing varied shelf arcs, play sessions aligned with co-op game nights, completions, ratings, drop reasons, friend library additions, and 19 organic co-op polls. Load at virtual_now >= 2026-12-31T12:00:00-08:00 (datasets/eval-2025-2026/clock.json, distinct from fixtures/clock.json 2026-11-20T16:30:00-08:00), or generate a pre-cutoff slice for any earlier clock via scripts/slice-dataset.cjs --cutoff <ISO>.

sources.description: 100% synthetic 2-year user game-library activity, friend library additions, and non-templated co-op poll history authored deterministically in scripts/build-eval-dataset.cjs (no RNG, no scraped store data, no real personal data).
20 programmatically rendered 640x360 PNG gameplay & proportional HUD preview screenshots generated by scripts/render-previews.py (Pillow) and cataloged in contribution/assets.catalog.json.

transformations: Validated against schemas/seed.schema.json, plugin.validateSeed chronological and clock invariants, and cross-record ownership/poll-tally consistency checks.

review.notes: 100% synthetic evaluation dataset verified across all 24 months (2025-01..2026-12) and multiple pre-cutoff slices (2025-06-15, 2026-11-20, 2026-12-31) via scripts/slice-dataset.cjs, scripts/coverage.cjs, and real stdio MCP tests; independent reviewer sign-off pending.
